provenance.notes: Verified on the official call for papers: main text between 6 and 10 pages (strictly enforced, 9 recommended), references unlimited, appendices unlimited, double-blind, template archive at github.com/ICLR/Master-Template (iclr2025.zip). The pages do NOT name the .sty file or give font/column rules: the name iclr2025_conference is the usual one and is unverified.

latex.class_file: iclr2025_conference.sty (download from the ICLR template archive)

limits.text: Main text 6 to 10 pages inclusive (9 recommended); strictly enforced: an 11th page of main text is desk-rejected. References and appendices do not count.

anonymity.text: Anonymous submissions; cite your own earlier work in the third person.

facts.text: Main text 6 to 10 pages, strictly enforced.
Style file name iclr2025_conference.sty; single column.
